asked: the same fly, walking and flying

body_length_m.source: DESIGN INPUT: 2.5 mm body length, the order of size Drosophila melanogaster is described at. Not measured here.

speed_m_s.source: DESIGN INPUT, swept: 5-20 mm/s walking. Not measured on any fly here.

gait.description: alternating tripod, six legs in two sets of three

cycle_hz.source: DESIGN INPUT, swept: step frequency asked of the design.

distance_per_cycle_m.source: DESIGN INPUT, swept: net advance per tripod cycle.

gait.source: DESIGN INPUT: the gait the design proposes

speed_m_s.source: DESIGN INPUT, swept: the airspeed the design is asked to reach in flight.

genotype.note: unchanged: this generation changed how the organism moves, not what it is made of.

what_it_taught: Walking is not contradicted and flight is refused for want of a lift coefficient measured on anything like an insect. Neither bears on lifespan. The locomotion layer is a second dimension beside shape, and the request was about a third one that still has no layer.
question: Can we design a fruit fly that lives longer?
